CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GenerateObjectUrl] ( @Type varchar(50), @TypeID int, @ObjectID int = 0, @ObjectUid uniqueidentifier, @useAssetUid bit = 0 ) RETURNS varchar(500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Prefix varchar(5) = '' DECLARE @Url varchar(500) SET @Url = @Prefix
IF @useAssetUid = 1 SET @Url = 'asset/' + + CAST(@ObjectUid as varchar(36)) ELSE BEGIN SET @Url = CASE @Type WHEN 'Artifact' THEN 'artifact/' + + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'ArtifactType' THEN 'artifact/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'ReferenceItem' THEN 'reference/' + + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'ReferenceItemType' THEN 'reference/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'Group' THEN 'groups/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'Lookup' THEN 'admin/lookups/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/' + + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'LookupType' THEN 'admin/lookups/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'Policy' THEN 'policy/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar(15)) + '/id/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'PolicyType' THEN 'policy/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/structure' WHEN 'Resource' THEN 'resource/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'resource/list/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'Rule' THEN 'quality/rule/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'RuleType' THEN 'quality/rule/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'Taxonomy' THEN 'model/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/id/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'TaxonomyType' THEN 'model/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/structure' WHEN 'ShoppingCartType' THEN 'cart/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) END END
SET @Url = @Prefix + @Url
RETURN @Url END
